title: Activation Rebalancer: INT8 calibration orchestration with runtime kernel selector
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Deliver an integrated calibration orchestration and runtime kernel selection layer that applies activation rebalancing (SmoothQuant-style) profiles at deploy time, but with a distinct operational flow: 1) automated per-layer rebalancing profile generation using representative sequences, 2) a latency-aware kernel selector that chooses between fused and per-op kernels, and 3) a conservative fallback mode to mixed-precision (FP16/FP8) for layers that fail accuracy or perf thresholds. This ticket covers the orchestration pipeline, the calibration dataset generation harness, validation metrics, QA harness, and the runtime shim that exposes per-deployment kernel policies to the serving runtime. Emphasis on reproducible accuracy checks and SLO-driven kernel choice to minimize customer regressions while optimizing unit cost.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline generates per-layer scale/rebalancer profiles and stores them in artifact bucket

Automated validation harness reports token-level and distributional accuracy deltas vs baseline FP16 for 3 benchmark models (Llama-2-13B, Falcon-40B, and internal customer-sim) and flags layers with >1.0% EM/LM degradation
Runtime implements kernel selector hooks that can route requests to fused-rebalancer kernels or safe per-op kernels based on latency budget and accuracy flags
Canary rollout on dedicated pool performs 72h soak with no customer-visible regressions; metrics dashboard shows stable p95 latency and token cost reduction >= 12%
Documentation and SDK flags exist so customers can opt into 'aggressive-rebalance' or 'conservative' modes
plan: 1) Prototype offline rebalancer that computes per-channel multipliers from representative batches (owner: ML infra)
2) Add synthetic sequence generator that samples from production prompt distribution for calibration (owner: Data Science)
3) Build calibration orchestration service that runs profiles across quantizers and emits artifacts (owner: Quant infra)
4) Implement runtime kernel selector with policy flags: latency_slos, accuracy_guard, and fallback_threshold (owner: Serving runtime)
5) Integrate end-to-end CI jobs: generate profiles -> validate -> package artifact -> load into canary runtime (owner: CI)
6) QA: run exhaustive evals and manual spot checks, fix accuracy edge-cases, and tune kernel selection heuristics (owner: QA)
7) Launch canary, observe for 72h, iterate, and schedule gradual rollout (owner: Eng/ProdOps)
test_plan: Unit tests for rebalancer math (channel-wise multiplier stability)
Integration test: calibration orchestration produces identical artifact schema across runs
Benchmark: accuracy and latency sweep for Llama-2-13B across sequence lengths [64,256,1024]
Soak test: canary dedicated pool with 10% production traffic for 72 hours
Chaos test: inject kernel fallback and verify no request-level panics or assertion failures
validation_results: Initial offline run (2025-02-15) on Llama-2-13B: avg token-level perplexity delta +0.3% vs fp16 with 13% token cost savings
Falcon-40B early pass (2025-02-17): found 2 layers with distribution shift; these layers marked for conservative fallback
Internal sim (2025-02-19): p95 latency reduced from 312ms -> 270ms under fused kernel path; fallback path p95 = 298ms
rollout_plan: Canary stage: 1 dedicated pool, 10% traffic, 72h soak
Stage 2: 3 additional pools, 30% traffic, 1 week stability checks
Stage 3: global gradual rollout by region with feature flag per-customer, include opt-out button in Console
Rollback: server-side feature flag to disable activation rebalancer per pool; immediate rollback window 30m
risks: Calibration overfit to synthetic prompts leading to real-user regressions
Edge-case layers where channel multipliers cause numeric instability in int8 path
Kernel fusion bugs causing subtle model-output drift
Operational complexity in managing multiple artifact versions across dedicated/private fleets
